questions.korean: 연구 결과가 그 이론을 뒷받침해.
answers: The research findings support the theory.
The study results back up the hypothesis.
questions.hint: support / back up = 뒷받침하다

questions.korean: 두 가지 요소가 그 결과에 영향을 미쳤어.
answers: Two factors influenced the result.
Two elements had an impact on the outcome.
questions.hint: influence / have an impact on = 영향을 미치다

questions.korean: 이 데이터는 다른 방식으로 해석될 수 있어.
answers: This data can be interpreted in different ways.
There are multiple ways to interpret this data.
questions.hint: be interpreted = 해석되다

questions.korean: 그 증거는 결론을 뒷받침하기에 충분하지 않아.
answers: The evidence is not sufficient to support the conclusion.
There isn't enough evidence to back up the conclusion.
questions.hint: sufficient / enough evidence to + 동사원형

questions.korean: 우리는 두 접근 방식을 비교할 필요가 있어.
answers: We need to compare the two approaches.
It's necessary to weigh the two methods against each other.
questions.hint: compare / weigh against = 비교하다

questions.korean: 서로 타협점을 찾아야 할 것 같아.
answers: We need to find a middle ground.
We should meet each other halfway.
questions.hint: find a middle ground / meet halfway = 타협점을 찾다

questions.korean: 그 조건에 동의할게.
answers: I can agree to those terms.
I'll go along with those conditions.
questions.hint: agree to / go along with = 동의하다, 수락하다

questions.korean: 그게 테이블 위에 올라와 있어. (논의 중)
answers: That's on the table.
That's up for discussion.
questions.hint: on the table / up for discussion = 논의 대상인

questions.korean: 거기서 타협할 수 없어.
answers: That's not negotiable.
I can't budge on that.
questions.hint: not negotiable / can't budge = 협상 불가, 양보 불가

questions.korean: 서로에게 유리한 합의를 찾아보자.
answers: Let's find an agreement that works for both of us.
Let's work toward a win-win solution.
questions.hint: win-win = 서로에게 유리한

questions.korean: 그 점에서는 동의하지만, 그렇다고 해서 전부 맞는 건 아니야.
answers: I agree on that point, but that doesn't mean everything is correct.
You have a point there, but that's not the whole story.
questions.hint: You have a point, but = 그 점은 맞지만

questions.korean: 내 생각에 당신은 요점을 놓치고 있는 것 같아.
answers: I think you're missing the point.
It seems like you're not seeing the bigger picture.
questions.hint: miss the point = 요점을 놓치다
questions.explanation: bigger picture = 전체적인 그림, 큰 그림

questions.korean: 그건 공정한 지적이야.
answers: That's a fair point.
That's a valid argument.
questions.hint: fair point / valid argument = 공정한 지적

questions.korean: 그건 내가 생각해보지 않은 부분이야.
answers: That's something I hadn't considered.
I hadn't thought about it that way.
questions.hint: hadn't considered / hadn't thought about

questions.korean: 정중하게 이의를 제기하고 싶어.
answers: I'd like to respectfully disagree.
With all due respect, I see it differently.
questions.hint: respectfully disagree / with all due respect = 정중하게 반박

questions.korean: 당신의 도움에 진심으로 감사드립니다.
answers: I truly appreciate your help.
I'm deeply grateful for your assistance.
questions.hint: truly appreciate / deeply grateful = 진심으로 감사하다

questions.korean: 불편을 드려 정말 죄송합니다.
answers: I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
I'm truly sorry for any trouble I've caused.
questions.hint: sincerely apologize / truly sorry for = 진심으로 사과하다

questions.korean: 그건 내 책임이야. 전적으로 내 잘못이야.
answers: That's on me. It was entirely my fault.
I take full responsibility for that.
questions.hint: that's on me = 내 책임이다
questions.explanation: take full responsibility = 전적인 책임을 지다

questions.korean: 시간 내주셔서 감사합니다.
answers: Thank you for taking the time.
I appreciate you making time for this.
questions.hint: thank you for taking the time = 시간 내주셔서 감사

questions.korean: 그건 괜찮아요. 걱정하지 마세요.
answers: It's no big deal. Don't worry about it.
Think nothing of it. It's fine.
questions.hint: no big deal / think nothing of it = 별거 아니에요

questions.korean: 별거 아니야, 다 잘 될 거야.
answers: It's not a big deal, everything will work out.
No worries, it'll all fall into place.
questions.hint: fall into place = 제자리를 잡다, 잘 풀리다

questions.korean: 그는 배짱이 있어.
answers: He has guts.
He's got nerve.
questions.hint: have guts / have nerve = 배짱이 있다, 담대하다

questions.korean: 완전 동의해!
answers: I'm totally on board with that!
I couldn't agree more!
questions.hint: be on board = 동의하다, 찬성하다

questions.korean: 그건 한계를 넘은 거야.
answers: That's crossing the line.
That went too far.
questions.hint: cross the line = 한계를 넘다

questions.korean: 그녀는 항상 한 발짝 앞서 있어.
answers: She's always one step ahead.
She's always ahead of the curve.
questions.hint: one step ahead / ahead of the curve = 앞서다
questions.explanation: ahead of the curve = 시대를 앞서가다

questions.korean: 내 친구 민수는, 내가 10년 전에 만난 사람인데, 지금 의사야.
answers: My friend Minsu, whom I met ten years ago, is now a doctor.
My friend Minsu, who I've known for ten years, became a doctor.
questions.hint: 비제한적 관계절: 쉼표 + who/whom
questions.explanation: 비제한적 관계절은 추가 설명을 쉼표로 삽입

questions.korean: 그 영화, 내가 작년에 봤는데, 정말 감동적이었어.
answers: The movie, which I watched last year, was really moving.
The film, which I saw last year, was very touching.
questions.hint: which = 사물을 수식하는 비제한적 관계절

questions.korean: 그의 집, 시내 중심에 있는데, 정말 편리해.
answers: His house, which is located downtown, is very convenient.
His apartment, which sits in the city center, is really convenient.
questions.hint: which is located / which sits = 위치를 나타내는 관계절

questions.korean: 그녀의 발표, 모두가 기다리던 건데, 정말 인상 깊었어.
answers: Her presentation, which everyone had been waiting for, was really impressive.
Her talk, which we'd all been anticipating, left a strong impression.
questions.hint: which everyone had been waiting for

questions.korean: 제주도는, 내가 가장 좋아하는 섬인데, 아름다운 자연을 가지고 있어.
answers: Jeju Island, which is my favorite island, has beautiful nature.
Jeju, which I love most, is known for its stunning landscapes.
questions.hint: which is my favorite = 추가 설명 관계절

questions.korean: 그 목표를 달성하기 위해 모든 노력을 기울였어.
answers: I made every effort to achieve the goal.
I gave it my all to reach the target.
questions.hint: make every effort / give it one's all = 최선을 다하다

questions.korean: 나는 실수를 반복하지 않기 위해 메모했어.
answers: I took notes so that I wouldn't repeat the mistake.
I wrote it down in order not to make the same mistake again.
questions.hint: so that + 주어 + wouldn't / in order not to

questions.korean: 결국 그들은 합의에 도달했어.
answers: They eventually reached an agreement.
They finally came to an agreement.
questions.hint: reach / come to an agreement = 합의에 이르다

questions.korean: 그 결과로 생산성이 크게 향상됐어.
answers: As a result, productivity improved significantly.
The outcome was a major improvement in productivity.
questions.hint: as a result / the outcome = 그 결과로

questions.korean: 충분한 연습을 통해 그녀는 자신감을 얻었어.
answers: Through enough practice, she gained confidence.
With sufficient practice, she built up her confidence.
questions.hint: through / with + 명사 + gained confidence

questions.korean: 그 관습은 시간이 지나면서 사라져가고 있어.
answers: That custom is fading away over time.
That tradition is gradually dying out.
questions.hint: fade away / die out = 사라지다, 소멸하다

questions.korean: 소셜 미디어는 사람들이 소통하는 방식을 바꿨어.
answers: Social media has changed the way people communicate.
Social media has transformed how we interact with each other.
questions.hint: has changed the way + 주어 + 동사

questions.korean: 그 두 문화 사이엔 큰 차이가 있어.
answers: There is a big gap between the two cultures.
The two cultures differ significantly from each other.
questions.hint: gap between / differ from = 차이가 있다

questions.korean: 사람들은 점점 더 개인주의적이 되고 있어.
answers: People are becoming more and more individualistic.
Society is growing increasingly individualistic.
questions.hint: more and more / increasingly + 형용사

questions.korean: 그것은 전 세계적으로 보편적인 문제야.
answers: It is a universal problem worldwide.
That's a global issue that affects everyone.
questions.hint: universal / global = 전 세계적인

questions.korean: 비록 그가 어리지만, 매우 성숙해.
answers: Although he is young, he is very mature.
Young as he is, he is surprisingly mature.
questions.hint: although + 절 / 형용사 + as + 주어 + 동사 (도치)
questions.explanation: Young as he is = 비록 어리지만 (문학적 표현)

questions.korean: 그것뿐만 아니라 그는 스포츠도 잘해.
answers: Not only that, but he is also good at sports.
Apart from that, he excels at sports.
questions.hint: not only that, but also / apart from that = 그것뿐만 아니라

questions.korean: 그는 아무런 불평 없이 받아들였어.
answers: He accepted it without any complaint.
He took it in stride without complaining.
questions.hint: without + 명사/~ing = ~ 없이

questions.korean: 그게 맞는 말이긴 하지만, 그래도 의구심이 생겨.
answers: That may be true, but it still raises questions.
While that's a fair point, it still leaves room for doubt.
questions.hint: that may be true, but = 그게 맞긴 하지만
questions.explanation: leave room for doubt = 의구심의 여지를 남기다

questions.korean: 좋든 싫든, 그 변화는 일어났어.
answers: Whether we like it or not, the change has happened.
Like it or not, the change is here to stay.
questions.hint: whether we like it or not / like it or not = 좋든 싫든
keywords: whether we like it or not

questions.korean: 그 상황이 통제를 벗어나기 전에, 우리는 조치를 취했어야 했는데.
answers: We should have taken action before the situation got out of hand.
We ought to have stepped in before things spiraled out of control.
questions.hint: should have + p.p. + before + 절

questions.korean: 비록 결과가 기대했던 것과 달랐지만, 우리는 많이 배웠어.
answers: Although the result was different from what we expected, we learned a lot.
Even though it didn't go as planned, we took a lot away from it.
questions.hint: although + 절 + we learned a lot

questions.korean: 한 발짝 물러서서 전체적인 그림을 볼 필요가 있어.
answers: We need to take a step back and look at the bigger picture.
It's important to step back and see the whole situation.
questions.hint: take a step back = 한 발짝 물러서다, bigger picture = 전체적인 그림

questions.korean: 앞으로 나아가기 위해, 과거의 실수들로부터 배워야 해.
answers: In order to move forward, we need to learn from past mistakes.
To make progress, it's essential to take lessons from our failures.
questions.hint: in order to move forward + learn from past mistakes

questions.korean: 결국, 중요한 건 네가 최선을 다했다는 거야.
answers: At the end of the day, what matters is that you did your best.
In the end, the important thing is that you gave it your all.
questions.hint: at the end of the day = 결국, 요컨대
keywords: at the end of the day
